2026-09-06.html:
Overreliance on AI may undermine students' ability to think independently.

过度依赖 AI 可能削弱学生独立思考的能力。

2. 核心结构

overreliance on sth
= 过度依赖……

undermine sth
= 削弱 / 损害
≈ make sth weaker

ability to do sth
= 做某事的能力

think independently
= 独立思考

3. 三个表达层级

基础

Excessive reliance on AI may have serious consequences for students' ability to think independently.

推荐

Overreliance on AI may undermine students' ability to think independently.

升级

Overreliance on AI may discourage students from thinking independently, thereby weakening their problem-solving abilities.

4. 必记词汇

overreliance = 过度依赖
undermine = 削弱、损害
impair = 损害、妨碍
capacity = 能力
independently = 独立地
consequence = 后果

5. 同义替换

excessive reliance on
→ overreliance on

weaken
→ undermine / impair

ability to think independently
→ capacity for independent thinking

6. 万能模板

Overreliance on X may undermine sb's ability to Y.

例：
Overreliance on technology may undermine people's ability to solve problems independently.

X may have serious consequences for Y.

例：
Persistent stress may have serious consequences for employees' performance.

7. 今日必背 Chunk

overreliance on sth
过度依赖……

undermine sb's ability to do sth
削弱某人做某事的能力

think independently
独立思考

have serious consequences for sth
对……产生严重后果
